title: Stops at 1500 level
content: This was fun, but it has stopped at level 1500 permanently. I should never have paid for anything. I feel cheated. This game needs to continue.

title: No timer but limited moves
content: Nothing like the real block game.  A little annoying because it takes you to the store in between each level but you don’t have to watch ads as they are at the bottom.

title: You say NO TIMER
content: What a misleading statement! You have a timer and what a waste for such a game. DONE with this game. You don’t even deserve the 1 star I had to give.

title: Fun but irritating
content: This is a super-addictive game, but there are some annoyances. One frustrating one is that every 7 days you’ll receive a “big prize” that will wipe out all the cheats that you’ve accumulated up to that point. 76 drills or air blowers, gone, poof. Another is that after Level 1500, you’ll start over at Level 1. That in itself isn’t so bad, but from that point on, you’ll start back at Level 1 every time you play the game. So at this point I’m done with it. Fun while it lasted.

title: Annoying ui and game play
content: Why do you need the store to pop up between every single level? Limiting the number of moves defeats the entire purpose of playing a no timer game.

title: Yes, TIMER!
content: Almost immediately an ad displayed asking me to pay for no ads. Am I misunderstanding something?

title: No Timer
content: Loving it so far. Very addictive

title: Impossible to pass level 61
content: It’s actually impossible to solve level 61 unless you watch ads or buy things. Not worth it

title: No exit door
content: There is no exit door for the 2x2 Green block in level 1302. I am using cheats to try and erase that block but it always chooses another block. Is there a way to solve this as I cannot move on from here

title: No timer but limited moves
content: Ok there’s no timer, but you have a limited number of moves which means you still can’t complete a level without buying more. Disappointing

title: Phew! Feels smooth
content: Loved the feeling of no stress of the timer when playing! Feels more strategic!

title: This is the best!👍👍
content: Not having a timer is a huge positive in this game, i don’t stress while waiting  for time to be over! I can strategise my moves for as long as i like 😂  nicely done love thiss 💯💯👍👍

title: Let down
content: No timer. Great! But then you have a limited amount of moves. Not impressed!

title: Disappointed - number of moves
content: I was excited to play a game with no timer but then you had to finish the puzzle with only so many moves. I was very disappointed
Iv finished the game twice but still obsessed

title: Typical app that starts out great
content: And then eventually uses tactics to try to manipulate you to spend money. Don’t download it. It’s trash.
